title: When Momentum Helps Polyak--Ruppert Averaging
abstract: arXiv:2610.27990v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Polyak--Ruppert averaging gives SGD and momentum methods the same asymptotic covariance. We characterize how fast finite runs reach it and how far they can be parallelized. For strongly convex quadratics with additive noise, we prove an online--offline bridge: the empirical risk minimizer on the samples of a tail average is one Newton step from the tail-averaged query point of any online procedure. For SGD, heavy ball, and Nesterov's method with constant momentum, this step is a boundary term at the two ends of the tail and splits the gap to the offline estimator into center, covariance, and shape errors. Necessary and sufficient conditions show that, on the least curved direction, the center error sets the pace: SGD needs $m\gg\kappa^2$ rounds but momentum only $m\gg\kappa$, where $\kappa$ is the condition number, so at sample size $N$ the critical batch size grows from $\Theta(\sqrt{N}/\kappa)$ to $\Theta(\sqrt{N/\kappa})$. translated_title: 动量何时有助于 Polyak--Ruppert 平均
translated_abstract: Polyak--Ruppert 平均使 SGD 与动量方法具有相同的渐近协方差。我们刻画了有限次运行多快能达到该渐近协方差，以及它们可以被并行化到何种程度。对于带加性噪声的强凸二次目标函数，我们证明了一座“在线—离线桥梁”：在尾平均所对应样本上的经验风险最小化器，与任何在线过程的尾平均查询点之间仅相差一个牛顿步。对于常数动量的 SGD、重球法和 Nesterov 方法，这一步表现为尾平均两端的一个边界项，并将与离线估计器之间的差距分解为中心误差、协方差误差和形状误差。充分必要条件表明，在曲率最小的方向上，中心误差决定了收敛节奏：SGD 需要 $m\gg\kappa^2$ 轮迭代，而动量方法只需 $m\gg\kappa$，其中 $\kappa$ 为条件数；因此在样本量为 $N$ 时，临界批量大小从 $\Theta(\sqrt{N}/\kappa)$ 增长到 $\Theta(\sqrt{N/\kappa})$。（注：原文摘要末尾被截断）
tldr: 该论文证明动量方法能加速有限次运行中 Polyak--Ruppert 平均向渐近协方差的收敛——SGD 需要 $m\gg\kappa^2$ 轮而动量只需 $m\gg\kappa$，从而使样本量 $N$ 下的临界批量大小从 $\Theta(\sqrt{N}/\kappa)$ 提升到 $\Theta(\sqrt{N/\kappa})$。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that momentum accelerates finite-run Polyak--Ruppert averaging toward its asymptotic covariance—requiring only $m\gg\kappa$ rounds versus $m\gg\kappa^2$ for SGD—thereby raising the critical batch size at sample size $N$ from $\Theta(\sqrt{N}/\kappa)$ to $\Theta(\sqrt{N/\kappa})$.
